name: Mr. Tokunbo Philip Wahab
department: Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources
bio: Mr. Tokunbo Philip Wahab is an accomplished and visionary legal practitioner with over 25 years of extensive practice. An alumnus of the prestigious Harvard Kennedy School of Government and Harvard Business School, he spearheads the transformative THEMES+ environmental sanitation, drainage infrastructure, and climate resilience agenda across Lagos State.
education: Harvard Kennedy School, Harvard Business School, University of Benin (LL.B)

name: Engr. Olakunle Olamidosu Rotimi-Akodu
role: Special Adviser to the Governor on Environment
bio: Engr. Olakunle Rotimi-Akodu is a distinguished engineer and environmental strategist with decades of leadership across civil engineering, environmental sustainability, and public administration. He plays a pivotal role in formulating and executing strategic grassroots sanitation and advocacy programmes.

name: Dr. Gaji Omobolaji Tajudeen
bio: Dr. Gaji Omobolaji Tajudeen is a career civil servant and seasoned administrator with comprehensive expertise in public health, municipal waste regulation, conservation, and environmental policy governance across Lagos State ministries.
education: Doctor of Public Health / Environmental Administration

name: Engr. Mahmood Olakunle Adegbite
department: Office of Drainage Services & Water Resources (ODS&WR)
bio: Engineer Mahmood Olakunle Adegbite is an astute civil engineer with vast experience in hydraulic systems, stormwater channel construction, canal dredging, and water resources management. He oversees the state's comprehensive flood mitigation infrastructure.
education: Master of Civil Engineering (Hydraulics & Water Resources)
